nodes.name: Every 5 Minutes
nodes.notes: Drives the metrics collection loop. Runs every 5 minutes, 288 times per day.

nodes.name: n8n Prometheus Metrics
nodes.notes: Pulls native n8n /metrics endpoint (Prometheus exposition format). Provides active workflows, queue depth, and per-workflow counters.

nodes.name: Aggregate Metrics
nodes.notes: Reduces raw execution lists into: totals (1h/24h/7d), per-workflow success/failure/avg-duration, active workflow count, queue depth.

nodes.name: Push to Prometheus Pushgateway
nodes.notes: Pushes aggregated gauges to the Prometheus pushgateway. Grafana scrapes the pushgateway every 15s.

nodes.name: Persist to Backend DB
nodes.notes: Mirrors the metrics snapshot into the Dayjoy backend's n8n_metrics table for long-term retention and the admin dashboard's 'Automation Health' panel.

nodes.name: Refresh Grafana Dashboard
nodes.notes: Triggers a Grafana dashboard refresh so the n8n Overview panel reflects the latest metrics without waiting for the next scrape interval.

meta.description: Every 5 minutes collects n8n execution metrics (1h/24h/7d totals, per-workflow success/failure/avg-duration, active workflow count, queue depth), pushes gauges to the Prometheus pushgateway, persists the snapshot to the backend DB, and triggers a Grafana dashboard refresh.
